newsitem.title: USA: US cash jet fuel gains ground amid focus on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: US cash jet fuel gains ground amid focus on Iraq.

text.p: U.S. cash jet fuel prices gained more ground Thursday, tacking another cent to Wednesday's sharp gains as NYMEX heating oil futures continued to climb amid concern over the likelihood of U.S. air strikes against Iraq.
But differentials were little changed, with New York Harbor aviation-quality 54-grade jet offered at 4.50 cents over October futures, traders said.
Gulf Coast 54-grade was offered at 1.35 cents over the screen, 0.10 cent firmer than Wednesday, players said.
